creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Rice
creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.subtitle: Creamy chicken in a garlicky sauce

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and keep warm.

method.title: Season and fry
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and half the mixed herbs. Fry in a little oil 5–6 mins each side until cooked through; slice.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: In the same pan cook onion 3–4 mins. Add garlic and chilli for 1 min. Pour in cream, add remaining herbs and a handful of Parmesan; simmer 2–3 mins.

method.title: Add the greens
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted, return the sliced chicken to the pan and coat in the sauce.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice. Top with extra Parmesan and cracked pepper.

creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.tip: Add mushrooms for extra flavour or swap the spinach for broccoli.

sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.title: Sticky Hoisin Beef Flatbreads
sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.subtitle: Quick, easy and packed with flavour!

method.title: Cook the beef
method.text: Fry the mince in a large pan over medium-high heat until browned. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in hoisin sauce, soy sauce and a splash of water. Simmer 5-7 minutes until thick and glossy.

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Thinly slice the red onion and cucumber, grate the carrots and chop the coriander.

method.title: Warm the breads
method.text: Heat flatbreads in a dry pan or in the oven a few minutes until warm and slightly crisp.

method.title: Assemble
method.text: Top each flatbread with sticky beef, fresh veg, coriander and sesame seeds. Add extra hoisin or mayo if liked.

sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.tip: Swap the beef for chicken or Quorn mince for a cheaper option that's just as tasty!

sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.title: Sweet Chilli Beef Noodles
sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.subtitle: Quick sticky chilli noodles

method.title: Prep veg & noodles
method.text: Slice red pepper, grate carrot, chop spring onions and crush garlic. Cover noodles with boiling water to soften.

method.title: Brown the mince
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan, add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up, about 4–5 minutes.

method.title: Stir in veg
method.text: Add red pepper, carrot and garlic to the pan and stir-fry 2–3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauces
method.text: Pour in sweet chilli and soy sauce, stir well and simmer 1–2 minutes so the flavours combine.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Drain noodles, add to the pan with spring onions and toss to coat. Divide between bowls and serve hot.

sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.tip: Stretch the meal with frozen peas or extra veg, and use spring onion whites in cooking for extra flavour.
